blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — To address growing concerns over Pax Silica, the Archdiocese of Cagayan de Oro-Commission on Social Apostolate and the Samdhana Institute convened a multi-stakeholder dialogue on Tuesday at the San Agustin Metropolitan Cathedral here. The whole-day event, themed “Opportunities, Risks and Responsibilities for People, Planet and Peace,” gathered members of the Interfaith Forum for Peace, Harmony and Solidarity at the Santiago Hayes Hall. Discussions centered on how Pax Silica impacts local communities, the environment, livelihoods, technology, and regional peace-building efforts. READ: Pax Silica brings promise – but at what cost?
